editorial.intro: A parametric garment system built around body form, measurements and adjustable design parameters.
editorial.introFa: یک سیستم پارامتریک طراحی پوشاک بر پایه‌ی فرم بدن، اندازه‌ها و پارامترهای قابل تنظیم.

caseStudy.label: PROJECT CONTEXT
caseStudy.title: From measurements to form
caseStudy.body: An independent exploration of how body measurements and adjustable parameters can shape a garment in a digital environment.

caseStudy.label: DESIGN CHALLENGE
caseStudy.title: Make complex relationships understandable
caseStudy.body: The experience needed to connect body form, measurement inputs and garment outcomes without making the underlying system feel abstract or technical.

caseStudy.label: DESIGN APPROACH
caseStudy.title: Connect input, model and iteration
caseStudy.body: The design exploration focused on visualising the body, mapping measurements and making parametric garment variations easier to understand and compare.

caseStudy.label: DESIGN OUTCOME
caseStudy.title: A clearer model for exploration
caseStudy.body: The resulting concept brings body visualisation, measurement mapping and garment exploration into one connected experience.

caseStudy.label: ROLE & SCOPE
caseStudy.title: Independent product design
caseStudy.body: Concept direction and product-interface exploration across the parametric garment system. Independent project, 2025–2026.

passport.periodBasis: Project is listed under Jobvision experience; exact project dates are not separately stated.

editorial.intro: An employee experience platform connecting survey creation, feedback and people analytics.
editorial.introFa: پلتفرم تجربه‌ی کارکنان برای ساخت نظرسنجی، دریافت بازخورد و تحلیل داده‌های منابع انسانی.

caseStudy.label: PROJECT CONTEXT
caseStudy.title: Turning employee feedback into usable insight
caseStudy.body: Pulse Check is an employee experience platform connecting survey creation, employee feedback and people analytics for HR teams.

caseStudy.label: DESIGN CHALLENGE
caseStudy.title: Connect the full feedback loop
caseStudy.body: The product needed to make it coherent to move from setting up a survey, to understanding participation, to interpreting quantitative and qualitative responses.

caseStudy.label: DESIGN APPROACH
caseStudy.title: Design the workflow as one system
caseStudy.body: I worked across survey setup, active survey states, reporting, heatmaps and open comments, keeping the information hierarchy consistent from collection to interpretation.

caseStudy.label: DESIGN OUTCOME
caseStudy.title: A more legible feedback experience
caseStudy.body: The designed experience connects survey operations with visual reporting and employee comments, helping HR teams move between high-level patterns and the feedback behind them.

caseStudy.label: ROLE & SCOPE
caseStudy.title: Product Designer · primary design ownership
caseStudy.body: I led the product design work within a two-person design team; the second designer’s involvement was primarily feedback and critique.

passport.periodBasis: User confirmed this is an independent project. The year range is a provisional estimate aligned with the MoNo independent-work period beginning September 2025; exact project dates remain unconfirmed.

editorial.intro: A map-led guide to discovering places, routes and local experiences across Iran.
editorial.introFa: راهنمایی نقشه‌محور برای کشف مکان‌ها، مسیرها و تجربه‌های محلی در ایران.

caseStudy.label: PROJECT CONTEXT
caseStudy.title: A map as a starting point for discovery
caseStudy.body: Iran Unseen is an independent digital experience for discovering places, routes and local experiences across Iran.

caseStudy.label: DESIGN CHALLENGE
caseStudy.title: Make exploration feel connected
caseStudy.body: A map-led product has to balance geographic context with enough detail to help people understand a place, compare options and decide where to go next.

caseStudy.label: DESIGN APPROACH
caseStudy.title: Bring map, place information and routes together
caseStudy.body: The concept organises discovery around the map, supported by place cards, categories, routes and saved locations.

caseStudy.label: DESIGN OUTCOME
caseStudy.title: A structured discovery model
caseStudy.body: The experience establishes a connected framework for browsing places and local experiences without separating geographic exploration from the information needed to act on it.

caseStudy.label: ROLE & SCOPE
caseStudy.title: Independent Product Designer
caseStudy.body: Independent product and experience design exploration, 2025–2026.

passport.periodBasis: Associated with Jobvision; exact project dates are not separately stated.

editorial.intro: A recruitment workspace for managing applicant information and hiring workflows.
editorial.introFa: فضای کاری جذب نیرو برای مدیریت اطلاعات متقاضیان و فرایندهای استخدام.

caseStudy.label: PROJECT CONTEXT
caseStudy.title: A clearer operational view of recruitment
caseStudy.body: Jobvision’s Applicant Tracking System supports recruitment operations. This portfolio case study focuses on the dashboard experience and its mobile presentation.

caseStudy.label: DESIGN CHALLENGE
caseStudy.title: Make the overview easier to scan
caseStudy.body: Recruitment dashboards bring multiple jobs, applicants and changing statuses into one workspace. The design challenge was to establish a clear hierarchy so the most relevant operational information is easier to find.

caseStudy.label: DESIGN APPROACH
caseStudy.title: Prioritise hierarchy and information density
caseStudy.body: The dashboard design focuses on grouping key information, creating clear visual priority between summary and detail, and adapting the layout for a narrower mobile viewport.

caseStudy.label: DESIGN OUTCOME
caseStudy.title: A dashboard-first experience
caseStudy.body: The delivered design work in this case is the ATS dashboard and its mobile view. The presentation is centred on the overview experience rather than implying ownership of the wider ATS product.

caseStudy.label: ROLE & SCOPE
caseStudy.title: Product Designer · dashboard experience
caseStudy.body: My contribution focused on the ATS dashboard and its mobile presentation. Other ATS screens and workflows were outside my design scope.

passport.periodBasis: User confirmed this project belongs to the Rastar period; dates follow résumé employment dates.

editorial.intro: An AI creative workspace presented across desktop, Persian-language and mobile interfaces.
editorial.introFa: فضای خلاقیت مبتنی بر هوش مصنوعی در نسخه‌های دسکتاپ، فارسی و موبایل.

caseStudy.label: PROJECT CONTEXT
caseStudy.title: A workspace for AI-assisted creativity
caseStudy.body: Humaani is an AI creative workspace designed to bring creative tools and related workflows into a coherent product environment.

caseStudy.label: DESIGN CHALLENGE
caseStudy.title: Make multiple capabilities feel like one product
caseStudy.body: The core challenge was to organise distinct creative modules into a system users could understand and move through, while maintaining consistency across languages and screen sizes.

caseStudy.label: DESIGN APPROACH
caseStudy.title: Start with structure, then build consistency
caseStudy.body: I worked end to end across information architecture, navigation, cross-module flows and a shared design system, including Persian and English experiences and responsive mobile layouts.

caseStudy.label: DESIGN OUTCOME
caseStudy.title: A connected, multi-surface workspace
caseStudy.body: The design establishes a consistent foundation across the workspace, its modules, bilingual interfaces and mobile experience.

caseStudy.label: ROLE & SCOPE
caseStudy.title: Product Designer · end-to-end design
caseStudy.body: End-to-end product design during a four-month engagement at Rastar, from information architecture and navigation through interface design and design-system work.

passport.periodBasis: User confirmed this project belongs to the Jobvision period; exact project dates are not separately stated.

editorial.intro: An executive talent platform with a focus on talent discovery and contact flows.
editorial.introFa: پلتفرم استعدادهای مدیریتی با تمرکز بر کشف استعداد و جریان‌های ارتباطی.

caseStudy.label: PROJECT CONTEXT
caseStudy.title: A focused experience for executive talent
caseStudy.body: Mirana is an executive talent platform centred on discovering relevant profiles and creating a path to contact.

caseStudy.label: DESIGN CHALLENGE
caseStudy.title: Support discovery without losing profile context
caseStudy.body: The experience needed to present executive talent clearly and make the next step—reviewing a profile or initiating contact—easy to understand across desktop and mobile.

caseStudy.label: DESIGN APPROACH
caseStudy.title: Connect profile discovery to contact
caseStudy.body: The design work represented in this case focuses on the executive talent interface, mobile experience and contact flow.

caseStudy.label: DESIGN OUTCOME
caseStudy.title: A more direct discovery-to-contact journey
caseStudy.body: The interface brings talent presentation and contact actions into a connected experience across the supplied desktop and mobile screens.

caseStudy.label: ROLE & SCOPE
caseStudy.title: Product Designer · Jobvision
caseStudy.body: Product design contribution within the Jobvision product portfolio, during the November 2023–April 2025 employment period.

editorial.intro: An FMCG marketplace spanning store operations, shopper data and reporting.
editorial.introFa: بازارگاه کالاهای تندمصرف با ابزارهای مدیریت فروشگاه، داده‌ی خریداران و گزارش‌گیری.

caseStudy.label: PROJECT CONTEXT
caseStudy.title: Operational tools for an FMCG marketplace
caseStudy.body: Pinket is an FMCG marketplace spanning store operations, shopper information, product details, reporting and the shopper journey.

caseStudy.label: DESIGN CHALLENGE
caseStudy.title: Serve operational and customer-facing needs
caseStudy.body: The product surfaces different kinds of information—from store and shopper data to product details and reports—alongside the shopper-facing journey.

caseStudy.label: DESIGN APPROACH
caseStudy.title: Design across connected touchpoints
caseStudy.body: The work covered the store dashboard, shopper overview, product information, reporting and shopper journey, with attention to consistent information structure across these touchpoints.

caseStudy.label: DESIGN OUTCOME
caseStudy.title: A broader marketplace experience
caseStudy.body: The designed surfaces connect operational views with the shopper journey, giving the product a consistent visual and interaction foundation across its key touchpoints.

caseStudy.label: ROLE & SCOPE
caseStudy.title: UI/UX Designer · two-person design team
caseStudy.body: Product interface and experience design as part of a two-person design team at Pinket.
